analysis.session_summary: The overnight tape was a broad risk-on dollar decline: DXY fell 0.16% and VIX dropped 3.195% while NZD led at +0.143% and JPY lagged at -0.141%. A 20:30 IAEA-Iran headline triggered sharp but partially faded moves, though most legs had no clear catalyst and were attributed to flow. EUR/USD closed +21.2 pips in three legs with no catalyst, and GBP/USD +26.9 pips. The coming US CPI and FOMC Waller speak can reset the tone.

themes.evidence: 20:30 IAEA-Iran headline pushed USD/JPY -17.7 pips (54% of leg), NZD/USD +5.0 (42%), USD/ZAR -207.7 (40%), USD/MXN -240.6 (33%) before fading.
Multiple legs show confidence none and notes 'too weak to own the move' or 'Nothing on the wire'; EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/CHF whipsawed without news.

currency_drivers.USD: No high-tier US data; broad dollar index fell 0.16% as risk appetite improved.
currency_drivers.EUR: No euro-area catalyst; tracked the broad USD decline and closed at its best.
currency_drivers.JPY: No domestic catalyst; funding currency sold hardest as risk sentiment improved.
currency_drivers.GBP: No UK data; sterling drifted higher with USD weakness and risk appetite.
currency_drivers.AUD: No domestic catalyst; early dip was bought, leaving a modest gain.
currency_drivers.CAD: No domestic catalyst; mildly softer, cushioning the fall in USD/CAD.
currency_drivers.CHF: No domestic catalyst; early bid faded sharply, retaining only 8% of its peak.
currency_drivers.NZD: No domestic catalyst; strongest major on risk-on extension, holding its range.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: Three legs—up 23.4, down 7.8, up 6.0—left spot +21.2 pips, with no leg tied to a clear catalyst.

scenarios.name: Asia extends risk-on, dollar soft
scenarios.thesis: Overnight risk bid continues; high-beta FX stays supported while USD/JPY remains heavy.
scenarios.invalidation: A break back above 158.069 or hawkish FOMC Waller comments.

pair_paths.rationale: Broad USD decline plus EUR closed at its best; no euro-specific resistance.
Sterling's risk-on tone and USD weakness support extension.
Selling was rejected and close near high, leaving room for drift higher.
Offsetting USD weakness and JPY funding weakness left spot nearly flat overnight.

scenarios.name: Consolidation around Asia mids
scenarios.thesis: After overnight swings, market digests with two-way flow and no fresh catalyst until FOMC Waller/CPI.
triggers: AUD/NZD and CHF/JPY keep recent ranges
scenarios.invalidation: A clean break of EUR/USD's 28.6-pip overnight range.

pair_paths.rationale: Close at 0.79 of range and no catalyst favors choppy consolidation.
Closed at 0.84 of range; two-way risk into London.
Wide overnight range with close at 0.89; no domestic driver.
Attempt rejected and close low in range; two-sided flow likely.

scenarios.name: Risk reset, USD rebound
scenarios.thesis: Hawkish Waller or stronger CPI anticipation lifts dollar, unwinding risk-on.
triggers: FOMC Waller pushes back on easing

pair_paths.rationale: USD rebound plus some yen weakness.

risks.why_it_matters: Could reignite USD and unwind risk-on.
May pre-empt CPI and lift USD/yields.
Geopolitical headline generated sharp intraday vol; follow-up can trigger fast reversals.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: FOMC Waller Speaks at 10:00 CET, then US Core CPI m/m (0.2% f/c vs 0.3% prev) and CPI m/m (0.3% f/c vs 0.6% prev) at 14:30 CET can reset USD and risk tone.
